description: Syntax highlighting and the Meeko language server for .meeko components
color.executionZone.serverBackground.des: Background of the lines of a .meeko file that run only on the server (<script server>).
color.executionZone.sharedBackground.des: Background of the lines of a .meeko file that run on both the server and the browser (the component setup).
color.executionZone.browserBackground.de: Background of the lines of a .meeko file that run only in the browser (after the first browser await and inside onMounted).

config.classes.completion.description: CSS class completion: auto delegates generated classes to Tailwind CSS IntelliSense when it is active and the project uses Tailwind; on includes all classes; off disables only this completion. Does not affect hover, definition or CSS variables.
config.classes.hover.description: CSS class hover: auto skips generated classes when Tailwind is active; on includes all classes; off disables only this hover.
config.classes.definition.description: Go to definition for CSS classes, independent of completion, hover and variables.
config.cssVariables.completion.descripti: CSS variable completion in .meeko files and .css stylesheets of the Meeko project. Does not affect hover, definition or classes.
config.cssVariables.hover.description: CSS variable hover with their values and source files, independent of completion and classes.
config.cssVariables.definition.descripti: Go to definition for CSS variables, independent of completion, hover and classes.
config.cssVariables.references.descripti: Find references of CSS variables in the package sources, independent of completion, hover, definition and rename.
config.cssVariables.rename.description: Rename CSS variables in the package sources, checking scope and collisions. Does not affect references or the other features.
config.languageServer.preferWorkspace.de: Uses the language server of the workspace's @meekojs/meeko package, so that the editor matches the project's compiler. The bundled server is used if that package is missing, if this setting is disabled or if the workspace is not trusted.
config.languageServer.warmup.description: On startup, prepares in the background the TypeScript program of the projects of the open .meeko tabs (or of up to two applications in the folder), so that the first component gets colors and hover without waiting about a second. Disable it to save memory in workspaces with many applications.
config.format.indentSections.description: When formatting, indents the content of each section (<script>, <script server>, <template> and <style>) by one level, like Prettier's vueIndentScriptAndStyle plus the template. If disabled, formatting removes that base indentation.
config.editor.executionZones.description: Marks where the code of a .meeko component runs: only on the server (<script server>), on both the server and the browser (the setup) or only in the browser (after the first browser await and inside onMounted). Zones are shown as a bar in the gutter and a faint line color; hover over the first line of a zone to see the explanation.
config.autoClosingTags.description: Closes template tags when typing > or </, like VS Code's HTML extension.
config.live.enabled.description: Connects to every `meeko dev` of the workspace through .meeko/dev/editor-bridge-<port>.json, shows the current value of each signal next to its declaration and on hover, and lets you edit it. Only in trusted workspaces and only with a development server on loopback.
config.live.inlineValues.description: Shows the live value of each signal at the end of its declaration line while `meeko dev` is running. If disabled, hover still shows the values.
config.trace.server.description: Enables the LSP trace of all Meeko servers. To see the messages, set the level of the Meeko channel to Trace.
semanticTokenModifier.signal.description: A Meeko signal (signal, useState, defineModel, useElementRef) and its usages.
semanticTokenModifier.computed.descripti: A derived value (computed) or a read-only Meeko signal and its usages.
semanticTokenModifier.resource.descripti: A Meeko data resource (useApi, useRpcQuery, useRpcMutation) and its usages.
semanticTokenModifier.reactive.descripti: A token of a template expression that reads a reactive value.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: In virtual documents, Meeko analyzes the open file and provides completion, hover, diagnostics and symbols. Features that require project files on disk, such as cross-file navigation and references, are not available.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode, Meeko uses its bundled language server, reads the project configuration statically, skips checking the project's page contracts and does not connect to meeko dev to show live values.
